wars.name: Aragonese conquest of Mallorca

wars.name: Conquest of Majorca by Peter IV of Aragon
wars.outcome: Peter IV conquered the Balearic Islands (May 1343) and Roussillon and Cerdanya (1344); James III was defeated and killed at Llucmajor on 25 October 1349 and the kingdom stayed in personal union with Aragon.

notes:
Dossier written from two pages (budget 1-2). Cliopatria's row (1279-1343, 3 shapes: 12,509 / 13,502 / 13,502 km2) is the Balearic Islands plus Roussillon and the Pyrenean Cerdanya valleys, 49 cells; it lacks Montpellier (page: 'signory of Montpellier') and the viscountcy of Carlat, and shows no loss of Mallorca in 1286-1295. The page's infobox gives 'Established: 1276' and an end of 1715 (the Nueva Planta decrees); this dossier ends the sovereign kingdom at Llucmajor on 25 October 1349 and carries the three Cliopatria years 1279-1343 forward with corrections; Cliopatria ends the row at 1343 (Peter IV's May 1343 invasion).

Not settled: (1) the vassalage of 1279 ('the Majorcan monarch reconciled and recognized the King of Aragon as his overlord'; Peter III decreed the king of Majorca was to be a [vassal, text cut]) belongs in the Crown of Aragon dossier as vassal_start/vassal_end for kingdom-of-majorca (rule 4); not in this ledger because the vassal's own dossier has no event type for it. (2) Peter III's occupation of the mainland in 1285 and the 1298 Treaty of Argelers are not on either page. (3) Menorca's date (Cliopatria 1305) and the sale of Montpellier (the page says only 'French possessions') need a page. (4) Carlat (Auvergne) is not drawn. (5) The page's table ends James III's reign in 1344, the text at Llucmajor in 1349.

Gazetteer names needed: place 'Menorca' (island, 4.0 E, 39.95 N) and region 'Cerdanya' (Pyrenean valley, 1.5-2.2 E, 42.3-42.5 N, Spain and France); radii used instead.
